name: Ördek
scene: An elegant duck swims among flowing pond waves and reeds inside an oval stained-glass panel.
notes: Redrawn from motif_duck with vitray_fox and vitray_lighthouse style references. Duck uses the warm pair; sky, reeds and water use the cool pair. Target 89–129 panes; raster inspection found 123 coloured connected components larger than 100 pixels (not a geometry audit). Reviewed both generations for closed lines, crossings, shading and colour pairs; regenerated once to remove the bill sliver, strengthen lead, separate junctions and restore an opaque white exterior. Remaining doubts: subtle colour variation persists within fills, a few crowded junctions in upper-left sky, feathers and lower waves may need separation, some reed tips are narrow, and some same-colour neighbours may merge during tracing. Palette lists intended flat tracing colours. Design sheet only; no geometry or game catalogue changes.
